title: Test arch_perf_probes.sh to 100% and clear it from the shell-coverage allowlist
objective: Cover the sixth of the sixteen untested fixes/lib libs, the diagnostic-probe half of diagnose_arch_performance.sh. Unlike the two libs before it this one contains no dead branch, so the whole job is test-writing: reaching the swap-pressure branch that depends on /proc/meminfo, and the governor branches that depend on a real /sys tree.
acceptance_criteria: arch_perf_probes.sh measures 100.00% (93/93) through lib/tests/run_all.sh, twice, the second run at --min 100 with exit 0.
check_shell_coverage.sh exits 0 for arch_perf_probes.sh with its allowlist line removed, i.e. with no exemption.
The check_memory_pressure swap branch is genuinely exercised with controlled figures, not skipped because this host happens to swap.
Every file in fixes/lib/tests stays under the repo's 250-line cap and passes shellcheck with no suppression added.
The five libs cleared earlier in the session still pass the gate.
out_of_scope: bt_adapter.sh, still exempt at 98.55% for the backslash-continued assignment flavour of defect (a).
The remaining ten untested fixes/lib libs.
verifier: bash linux_configuration/scripts/single_use/fixes/lib/tests/run_all.sh (expects all 21 files passing, 16 + 27 for the two arch_perf_probes files), plus bash meta/scripts/shell_coverage_jail.sh --subject linux_configuration/scripts/single_use/fixes/lib/tests/run_all.sh --measure arch_perf_probes.sh --min 100 --fail-on-case-error -- "" (expects 93/93 = 100.00% and exit 0), plus bash meta/scripts/check_shell_coverage.sh linux_configuration/scripts/single_use/fixes/lib/arch_perf_probes.sh (expects exit 0).
